verdict.rationale: Paxos publishes API reference pages (e.g., List Transfers, Create Fiat Account) and an AI assistant in its docs, but nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. The Sandbox is a separate test environment, and the docs AI assistant is an adjacent feature, so neither counts as an interactive API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
